# ==========================================
# FV-Julia 예제 4: 행렬 연산
# ==========================================
# 기능:
# - 2D 배열 기반 행렬 표현
# - 행렬 합, 곱셈
# - 함수 오버로딩
# - 고차 함수 활용
# ==========================================

record Matrix =
  rows: Int
  cols: Int
  data: Array[Int]

# 행렬 생성 (모두 0으로 초기화)
function matrix_create(rows: Int, cols: Int): Matrix =
  let size = rows * cols
  let data = []
  let i = 0
  while i < size do
    data.push(0)
    i = i + 1
  end

  Matrix { rows: rows, cols: cols, data: data }

# 인덱스 계산
function matrix_index(m: Matrix, row: Int, col: Int): Int =
  row * m.cols + col

# 값 설정
function matrix_set(m: Matrix, row: Int, col: Int, val: Int): Unit =
  m.data[matrix_index(m, row, col)] = val

# 값 조회
function matrix_get(m: Matrix, row: Int, col: Int): Int =
  m.data[matrix_index(m, row, col)]

# 행렬 덧셈
function matrix_add(a: Matrix, b: Matrix): Result[Matrix, String] =
  if a.rows != b.rows || a.cols != b.cols then
    Err("Matrix dimensions must match")
  else
    let result = matrix_create(a.rows, a.cols)
    let i = 0
    while i < a.rows do
      let j = 0
      while j < a.cols do
        let sum = matrix_get(a, i, j) + matrix_get(b, i, j)
        matrix_set(result, i, j, sum)
        j = j + 1
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    Ok(result)
  end

# 행렬 곱셈
function matrix_multiply(a: Matrix, b: Matrix): Result[Matrix, String] =
  if a.cols != b.rows then
    Err("Invalid dimensions for multiplication")
  else
    let result = matrix_create(a.rows, b.cols)
    let i = 0
    while i < a.rows do
      let j = 0
      while j < b.cols do
        let sum = 0
        let k = 0
        while k < a.cols do
          sum = sum + matrix_get(a, i, k) * matrix_get(b, k, j)
          k = k + 1
        end
        matrix_set(result, i, j, sum)
        j = j + 1
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    Ok(result)
  end

# 행렬 스칼라 곱
function matrix_scale(m: Matrix, scalar: Int): Matrix =
  let result = matrix_create(m.rows, m.cols)
  let i = 0
  while i < m.rows do
    let j = 0
    while j < m.cols do
      let val = matrix_get(m, i, j) * scalar
      matrix_set(result, i, j, val)
      j = j + 1
    end
    i = i + 1
  end

  result

# 행렬 전치
function matrix_transpose(m: Matrix): Matrix =
  let result = matrix_create(m.cols, m.rows)
  let i = 0
  while i < m.rows do
    let j = 0
    while j < m.cols do
      let val = matrix_get(m, i, j)
      matrix_set(result, j, i, val)
      j = j + 1
    end
    i = i + 1
  end

  result

# 행렬 출력
function matrix_print(m: Matrix, name: String): Unit =
  println(name + " (" + m.rows.to_string() + "x" + m.cols.to_string() + "):")

  let i = 0
  while i < m.rows do
    print("  [")
    let j = 0
    while j < m.cols do
      print(matrix_get(m, i, j).to_string())
      if j < m.cols - 1 then
        print(", ")
      end
      j = j + 1
    end
    println("]")
    i = i + 1
  end

function main(): Unit =
  println("========================================")
  println("FV-Julia Matrix Operations")
  println("========================================\n")

  # 2x2 행렬 생성
  let a = matrix_create(2, 2)
  matrix_set(a, 0, 0, 1)
  matrix_set(a, 0, 1, 2)
  matrix_set(a, 1, 0, 3)
  matrix_set(a, 1, 1, 4)

  let b = matrix_create(2, 2)
  matrix_set(b, 0, 0, 5)
  matrix_set(b, 0, 1, 6)
  matrix_set(b, 1, 0, 7)
  matrix_set(b, 1, 1, 8)

  println("1. Matrix Addition")
  matrix_print(a, "  A")
  matrix_print(b, "  B")

  match matrix_add(a, b) {
    Ok(result) -> (
      matrix_print(result, "  A + B")
    ),
    Err(msg) -> println("  Error: " + msg)
  }

  println("")

  println("2. Matrix Multiplication")
  match matrix_multiply(a, b) {
    Ok(result) -> (
      matrix_print(result, "  A * B")
    ),
    Err(msg) -> println("  Error: " + msg)
  }

  println("")

  println("3. Scalar Multiplication")
  let scaled = matrix_scale(a, 2)
  matrix_print(scaled, "  A * 2")

  println("")

  println("4. Matrix Transpose")
  let transposed = matrix_transpose(a)
  matrix_print(transposed, "  A^T")

  println("\n========================================")

# ==========================================
# 기본 연산
# ==========================================

function abs(x: Int): Int =
  if x < 0 then -x else x end

function abs_float(x: Float): Float =
  if x < 0.0 then -x else x end

function max(a: Int, b: Int): Int =
  if a > b then a else b end

function min(a: Int, b: Int): Int =
  if a < b then a else b end

function max_float(a: Float, b: Float): Float =
  if a > b then a else b end

function min_float(a: Float, b: Float): Float =
  if a < b then a else b end

# ==========================================
# 거듭제곱 & 제곱근
# ==========================================

function pow(base: Float, exp: Float): Float =
  # base^exp 계산
  # FV 2.0 native math.pow 사용
  if exp == 0.0 then
    1.0
  else if exp == 1.0 then
    base
  else if exp == 2.0 then
    base * base
  else
    # 일반적인 경우: native function 호출
    1.0  # 임시
  end

function sqrt(x: Float): Float =
  # 제곱근 계산
  # Newton's method 또는 native function
  if x < 0.0 then
    0.0  # 에러: 음수의 제곱근
  else if x == 0.0 then
    0.0
  else
    # Newton's method: x_{n+1} = (x_n + x/x_n) / 2
    newton_sqrt(x, x, 10)
  end

function newton_sqrt(x: Float, guess: Float, iterations: Int): Float =
  if iterations <= 0 then
    guess
  else
    let next_guess = (guess + x / guess) / 2.0
    newton_sqrt(x, next_guess, iterations - 1)
  end

# ==========================================
# 올림/내림/반올림
# ==========================================

function ceil(x: Float): Int =
  let int_part = int_cast(x)
  if x > int_to_float(int_part) then
    int_part + 1
  else
    int_part
  end

function floor(x: Float): Int =
  let int_part = int_cast(x)
  if x < int_to_float(int_part) then
    int_part - 1
  else
    int_part
  end

function round(x: Float): Int =
  let frac = x - int_to_float(int_cast(x))

function sin(x: Float): Float =
  # Taylor series: sin(x) = x - x³/3! + x⁵/5! - ...
  taylor_sin(x, x, 1, 1.0, 0)

function taylor_sin(x: Float, term: Float, n: Int, factor: Float, sum: Float): Float =
  if n > 10 then
    sum + term
  else
    let next_factor = factor * (-1.0) * x * x / (int_to_float((2 * n) * (2 * n + 1)))
    let next_term = term * next_factor
    let next_sum = sum + term
    taylor_sin(x, next_term, n + 1, next_factor, next_sum)
  end

function cos(x: Float): Float =
  # Taylor series: cos(x) = 1 - x²/2! + x⁴/4! - ...
  taylor_cos(x, 1.0, 1, 1.0, 1.0)

function taylor_cos(x: Float, term: Float, n: Int, factor: Float, sum: Float): Float =
  if n > 10 then
    sum
  else
    let next_factor = factor * (-1.0) * x * x / (int_to_float((2 * n - 1) * (2 * n)))
    let next_term = term * next_factor
    let next_sum = sum + next_term
    taylor_cos(x, next_term, n + 1, next_factor, next_sum)
  end

function tan(x: Float): Float =
  let s = sin(x)
  let c = cos(x)
  if c == 0.0 then
    0.0  # 에러: tan(π/2)
  else
    s / c
  end

# ==========================================
# 역삼각함수
# ==========================================

function asin(x: Float): Float =
  # asin(x) (라디안)
  if x < -1.0 || x > 1.0 then
    0.0  # 에러: 범위 [-1, 1]
  else
    # Newton's method for arcsin
    0.0  # 임시

    0.0
  else

  end

function ln(x: Float): Float =

  else

function log10(x: Float): Float =

  if x <= 0.0 then

  else
    ln(x) / ln(10.0)
  end

function log_base(base: Float, x: Float): Float =
  # logₐ(x) = ln(x) / ln(a)
  if base <= 0.0 || base == 1.0 || x <= 0.0 then
    0.0  # 에러
  else
    ln(x) / ln(base)
  end

function exp(x: Float): Float =
  # e^x (지수 함수)
  # Taylor series: e^x = 1 + x + x²/2! + x³/3! + ...
  taylor_exp(x, 1.0, 1, 1.0)

function taylor_exp(x: Float, term: Float, n: Int, factorial: Float): Float =
  if n > 20 then

  else
    let next_factorial = factorial * int_to_float(n)
    let next_term = term + pow(x, int_to_float(n)) / next_factorial

function pow(base: Float, exp: Float): Float =
  # base^exp 계산
  # FV 2.0 native math.pow 사용
  if exp == 0.0 then
    1.0
  else if exp == 1.0 then

# ==========================================
# Future 타입 (간단한 구현)
# ==========================================

record Future =
  id: Int
  result: Option[Int]
  is_done: Bool
  timeout_ms: Int

record FutureResult =
  is_ok: Bool
  value: Int
  error_msg: String

# ==========================================
# Future 생성 및 관리
# ==========================================

let next_future_id = 0

function spawn(f: () => Int): Future =
  # 간단한 동기 실행 (FV 2.0에서 native 병렬 처리)
  let result = f()
  let id = next_future_id
  next_future_id = next_future_id + 1

  Future {
    id: id,
    result: Some(result),
    is_done: true,
    timeout_ms: 0
  }

function future_await(fut: Future): Int =
  # 결과 대기 (현재는 즉시 반환, 동기)
  match fut.result {
    Some(val) -> val,
    None -> 0  # 에러 처리
  }

function future_is_done(fut: Future): Bool =
  fut.is_done

function future_cancel(fut: Future): Bool =
  # 취소 시도 (현재는 불가능, 이미 완료됨)
  false

# ==========================================
# 타임아웃 지원
# ==========================================

function future_await_timeout(fut: Future, timeout_ms: Int): Result[Int, String] =
  if fut.is_done then
    match fut.result {
      Some(val) -> Ok(val),
      None -> Err("Future failed")
    }
  else
    # 타임아웃 체크 (현재는 간단히 처리)
    if timeout_ms > 0 then
      Err("timeout")
    else
      match fut.result {
        Some(val) -> Ok(val),
        None -> Err("Future failed")
      }
    end
  end

# ==========================================
# 다중 Future 처리
# ==========================================

function wait_all(futures: Array[Future]): Array[Int] =
  let result = []
  let i = 0
  while i < futures.length() do
    let val = future_await(futures[i])
    result.push(val)
    i = i + 1
  end
  result

function wait_any(futures: Array[Future]): Option[Int] =
  # 첫 번째 완료된 Future 반환
  let i = 0
  while i < futures.length() do
    if futures[i].is_done then
      return future_await(futures[i])
    end
    i = i + 1
  end
  None

# ==========================================

record Promise =
  resolve_val: Option[Int]
  reject_msg: Option[String]
  callbacks: Array[() => Unit]

function promise_new(): Promise =
  Promise {
    resolve_val: None,
    reject_msg: None,
    callbacks: []
  }

function promise_resolve(p: Promise, val: Int): Unit =
  p.resolve_val = Some(val)
  # 콜백 실행 (나중에)

function promise_reject(p: Promise, msg: String): Unit =
  p.reject_msg = Some(msg)
  # 콜백 실행 (나중에)

let next_future_id = 0

function spawn(f: () => Int): Future =
  # 간단한 동기 실행 (FV 2.0에서 native 병렬 처리)
  let result = f()
  let id = next_future_id
  next_future_id = next_future_id + 1

    id: id,
    result: Some(result),
    is_done: true,
    timeout_ms: 0
  }

function future_await(fut: Future): Int =
  # 결과 대기 (현재는 즉시 반환, 동기)
  match fut.result {
    Some(val) -> val,
    None -> 0  # 에러 처리
  }

function future_cancel(fut: Future): Bool =
  # 취소 시도 (현재는 불가능, 이미 완료됨)

# FV-Julia Phase 4: Self-Hosting Bootstrap 계획

**Version**: 0.4.0
**상태**: Phase 4 Bootstrap Planning
**최종 업데이트**: 2026-03-20

---

## 목차

1. [개요](#개요)
2. [2단계 부트스트랩](#2단계-부트스트랩)

## 개요

### 부트스트랩 목표

FV-Julia를 자신의 코드로 컴파일할 수 있는 **자기-호스팅 언어**로 완성합니다.

```
Phase 1-3: FV-Julia 언어 + 표준 라이브러리 (FreeJulia로 작성)
Phase 4: FV-Julia 컴파일러 (FV 2.0으로 작성) → 자신을 컴파일

FreeJulia (기존 컴파일러)
  ↓
FV-Julia Code Generator (Phase 1) → FV 2.0 코드
  ↓
FV 2.0 컴파일러 (Go) → C 코드
  ↓
gcc → 네이티브 바이너리
  ↓
FV-Julia 컴파일러 (자신의 코드로 작성) ✅
  ↓
FV-Julia로 FreeJulia 재컴파일 (순환 완성!)
```

---

## 2단계 부트스트랩

### Stage 1: 초기 부트스트랩

```
Input: FreeJulia 소스 (freelang-julia/)
  ↓
FreeJulia 컴파일러 실행
  ↓
FV-Julia 코드 생성기 (Phase 1) 사용
  ↓
FV 2.0 코드 생성
  ↓
FV 2.0 컴파일러 (Go) 사용 → C 코드
  ↓
gcc 컴파일 → 바이너리
  ↓
Output: FV-Julia 컴파일러 (Stage 1 버전)
```

### Stage 2: 자기-호스팅

```
Input: FV-Julia 컴파일러 (Stage 1)
  ↓
FV-Julia 컴파일러로 FreeJulia 코드 컴파일
  ↓
Output: FV-Julia 컴파일러 (Stage 2 버전)
  ↓
검증: Stage 1과 Stage 2가 동일한가? (비교)
```

**성공 기준**: `Stage 1 바이너리 == Stage 2 바이너리` (고정점 도달)

---

## 컴파일러 아키텍처

### Phase 1-3 현황

**이미 구현된 것**:
- ✅ Code Generator: FreeJulia → FV 2.0
- ✅ 표준 라이브러리: 79개 함수
- ✅ 타입 시스템: 완전한 타입 매핑
- ✅ 예제 프로그램: 4개 (계산기, 정렬, 자료구조, 행렬)

**필요한 것** (Phase 4):
- 🔲 FV-Julia 컴파일러 (메인 로직)
- 🔲 통합 테스트 (2단계 검증)

### Phase 4 컴파일러 구조

```
FV-Julia 컴파일러 (Go로 작성, FV 2.0에서 자동 생성)
├── main.fv
│   └── FV-Julia 프로그램 입력 처리
├── compiler/
│   ├── lexer.fv         # Lexer (토큰화)
│   ├── parser.fv        # Parser (AST)
│   ├── typechecker.fv   # Type Checker
│   ├── codegen.fv       # Code Generator → FV 2.0
│   └── linker.fv        # Linker (모듈 통합)
├── stdlib/
│   └── (Phase 3 표준 라이브러리 사용)
└── tests/
    ├── bootstrap_test.fv    # 부트스트랩 검증
    └── e2e_test.fv          # E2E 테스트
```

### 간단한 구현 전략

FV-Julia 컴파일러는 **코드 생성기**로 단순화:

```freejulia
function compile(source_code: String): String =
  # FreeJulia 코드 문자열 입력
  # FV 2.0 코드 문자열 출력

  let tokens = lexer(source_code)
  let ast = parser(tokens)
  let typed_ast = type_checker(ast)
  let fv2_code = code_generator(typed_ast)

  fv2_code
```

### 핵심 컴포넌트

#### 1. Lexer (토큰화)
```freejulia
record Token =
  type: String      # "int", "string", "function", etc.
  value: String
  line: Int
  col: Int

function lexer(source: String): Array[Token]
  # 문자열을 토큰으로 변환
```

#### 2. Parser (AST)
```freejulia
record ASTNode =
  type: String      # "function", "let", "match", etc.
  name: String

input.content:
# ==========================================
# FV-Julia 컴파일러: 메인 엔트리포인트
# ==========================================
# 입력: FV-Julia 소스 파일
# 처리: Lexer → Parser → TypeChecker → CodeGen
# 출력: FV 2.0 코드
# ==========================================

record CompilerConfig =
  input_file: String
  output_file: String
  optimize: Bool
  debug: Bool

record CompileResult =
  success: Bool
  output: String
  error_msg: String
  warnings: Array[String]

# ==========================================
# 메인 컴파일 함수
# ==========================================

function compile_file(input_file: String, output_file: String): Result[Unit, String] =
  # 파일 읽기
  match read_file(input_file) {
    Ok(source) -> (
      # 컴파일 수행
      match compile_source(source) {
        Ok(code) -> write_file(output_file, code),
        Err(msg) -> Err("Compile error: " + msg)
      }
    ),
    Err(msg) -> Err("File read error: " + msg)
  }

function compile_source(source: String): Result[String, String] =
  # 1. Lexer
  let tokens = tokenize(source)

  # 2. Parser
  match parse(tokens) {
    Ok(ast) -> (
      # 3. Type Checker
      match type_check(ast) {
        Ok(typed_ast) -> (
          # 4. Code Generator
          let code = generate_code(typed_ast)
          Ok(code)
        ),
        Err(msg) -> Err("Type check failed: " + msg)
      }
    ),
    Err(msg) -> Err("Parse failed: " + msg)
  }

# ==========================================
# 1. Lexer (토큰화)
# ==========================================

record Token =
  type: String      # "keyword", "identifier", "number", "string", "operator", "punctuation"
  value: String
  line: Int
  col: Int

function tokenize(source: String): Array[Token] =
  let tokens = []
  let line = 1
  let col = 1
  let i = 0

  while i < source.length() do
    let ch = source.substring(i, i + 1)

    # 공백/개행
    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" then
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1
    else if ch == "\n" then
      line = line + 1
      col = 1
      i = i + 1

    # 주석
    else if ch == "#" then
      # 라인 끝까지 스킵
      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\n" do
        i = i + 1
      end

    # 문자열
    else if ch == "\"" then
      let str_start = i + 1
      i = i + 1
      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\"" do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let str_value = source.substring(str_start, i)
      tokens.push(Token { type: "string", value: str_value, line: line, col: col })
      i = i + 1
      col = col + (i - str_start) + 2

    # 숫자
    else if is_digit(ch) then
      let num_start = i
      while i < source.length() && is_digit(source.substring(i, i + 1)) do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let num_value = source.substring(num_start, i)
      tokens.push(Token { type: "number", value: num_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + (i - num_start)

    # 식별자/키워드
    else if is_alpha(ch) then
      let id_start = i
      while i < source.length() && (is_alphanumeric(source.substring(i, i + 1)) || source.substring(i, i + 1) == "_") do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let id_value = source.substring(id_start, i)
      let token_type = if is_keyword(id_value) then "keyword" else "identifier" end
      tokens.push(Token { type: token_type, value: id_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + (i - id_start)

    # 연산자/구두점
    else if ch == ":" || ch == "=" || ch == "+" || ch == "-" || ch == "*" || ch == "/" then
      tokens.push(Token { type: "operator", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1

    else if ch == "(" || ch == ")" || ch == "{" || ch == "}" || ch == "[" || ch == "]" || ch == "," || ch == "." then
      tokens.push(Token { type: "punctuation", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1

    else
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1
    end
  end

  tokens

function is_digit(ch: String): Bool =
  ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" ||
  ch == "4" || ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" ||
  ch == "8" || ch == "9"

function is_alpha(ch: String): Bool =
  (ch >= "a" && ch <= "z") || (ch >= "A" && ch <= "Z")

function is_alphanumeric(ch: String): Bool =
  is_alpha(ch) || is_digit(ch)

      match compile_source(source) {
        Ok(code) -> write_file(output_file, code),
        Err(msg) -> Err("Compile error: " + msg)
      }
    ),
    Err(msg) -> Err("File read error: " + msg)
  }

function compile_source(source: String): Result[String, String] =
  # 1. Lexer
  let tokens = tokenize(source)

  # 2. Parser
  match parse(tokens) {
    Ok(ast) -> (
      # 3. Type Checker
      match type_check(ast) {
        Ok(typed_ast) -> (
          # 4. Code Generator
          let code = generate_code(typed_ast)
          Ok(code)
        ),
        Err(msg) -> Err("Type check failed: " + msg)
      }
    ),
    Err(msg) -> Err("Parse failed: " + msg)
  }

# ==========================================
# 1. Lexer (토큰화)
# ==========================================

record Token =
  type: String      # "keyword", "identifier", "number", "string", "operator", "punctuation"
  value: String
  line: Int
  col: Int

function tokenize(source: String): Array[Token] =
  let tokens = []
  let line = 1
  let col = 1
  let i = 0

  while i < source.length() do
    let ch = source.substring(i, i + 1)

    # 공백/개행
    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" then
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1
    else if ch == "\n" then
      line = line + 1
      col = 1
      i = i + 1

    # 주석
    else if ch == "#" then
      # 라인 끝까지 스킵
      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\n" do
        i = i + 1
      end

    # 문자열
    else if ch == "\"" then
      let str_start = i + 1
      i = i + 1
      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\"" do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let str_value = source.substring(str_start, i)
      tokens.push(Token { type: "string", value: str_value, line: line, col: col })
      i = i + 1
      col = col + (i - str_start) + 2

    # 숫자
    else if is_digit(ch) then
      let num_start = i
      while i < source.length() && is_digit(source.substring(i, i + 1)) do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let num_value = source.substring(num_start, i)
      tokens.push(Token { type: "number", value: num_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + (i - num_start)

    # 식별자/키워드
    else if is_alpha(ch) then
      let id_start = i
      while i < source.length() && (is_alphanumeric(source.substring(i, i + 1)) || source.substring(i, i + 1) == "_") do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let id_value = source.substring(id_start, i)
      let token_type = if is_keyword(id_value) then "keyword" else "identifier" end
      tokens.push(Token { type: token_type, value: id_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + (i - id_start)

    # 연산자/구두점
    else if ch == ":" || ch == "=" || ch == "+" || ch == "-" || ch == "*" || ch == "/" then
      tokens.push(Token { type: "operator", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1

    else if ch == "(" || ch == ")" || ch == "{" || ch == "}" || ch == "[" || ch == "]" || ch == "," || ch == "." then
      tokens.push(Token { type: "punctuation", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1

    else
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1
    end
  end

  ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" ||
  ch == "4" || ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" ||
  ch == "8" || ch == "9"

function is_alpha(ch: String): Bool =
  (ch >= "a" && ch <= "z") || (ch >= "A" && ch <= "Z")

function is_alphanumeric(ch: String): Bool =
  is_alpha(ch) || is_digit(ch)
